_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. config.json is git-ignored.
Only the hardware and the site live here. The station identity, broker
password and heartbeat token are NOT in this file - they arrive from
/api/stations/enroll when you redeem a setup code, and are written to
station.json. That way this repo carries no secrets and one SD card image

relay._comment: BCM pin numbering, not physical pin position.

display._comment: Set false when running headless over SSH for a wiring test.
